lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Lightning Dark Angel
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Lightning Dark Angel. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Lightning Dark Angels in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Lightning Dark Angel
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Lightning Dark Angel
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Lightning Dark Angel bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Lightning Dark Angel
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Lightning Dark Angel — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Lightning Dark Angel is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Lightning Dark Angel Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Lightning Dark Angel now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Lightning Dark Angels have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Wisp Grand Grand Crusader
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Grand Grand Crusader. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Grand Grand Crusaders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Grand Grand Crusader
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Chaos Fallen Angel — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Chaos Fallen Angel is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Chaos Fallen Angel Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Chaos Fallen Angel now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Chaos Fallen Angels have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_7.name: God-King Chaos Fallen Angel
star_7.appearance: The final form. Chaos Fallen Angel stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Chaos Fallen Angel is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Spawn Celestial Monk Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Celestial Monk Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Celestial Monk Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Emerging Celestial Monk Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Shrine Priest VII — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Shrine Priest VII is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Shrine Priest VII of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Shrine Priest VII now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Shrine Priest VIIs have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_7.name: Absolute Shrine Priest VII

tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Young Temple Monk
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Temple Monk. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Temple Monks in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Temple Monk
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Bud Ether Ifrit Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ether Ifrit Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Ether Ifrit Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Ether Ifrit Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Chosen Archangel Minor
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Chosen Archangel Minor bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Chosen Archangel Minor
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Chosen Archangel Minor — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Chosen Archangel Minor is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Chosen Archangel Minor the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Chosen Archangel Minor now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Chosen Archangel Minors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Titan Odin All-Father — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Titan Odin All-Father is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Titan Odin All-Father the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Titan Odin All-Father now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Titan Odin All-Fathers have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_7.name: Eternal Titan Odin All-Father
star_7.appearance: The final form. Titan Odin All-Father stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Wisp Hollow Temple Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hollow Temple Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Hollow Temple Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Hollow Temple Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Hatchling Sacred Sprite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sacred Sprite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Sacred Sprites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Sacred Sprite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: Church Knight Beta of the Apex

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Cult Order-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Chosen Acolyte
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Chosen Acolyte. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Chosen Acolytes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Chosen Acolyte
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Seed Church Monk

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Lunar Valkyrie
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Lunar Valkyrie bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Lunar Valkyrie
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Lunar Valkyrie — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Lunar Valkyrie is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Lunar Valkyrie the Last
star_6.appearance: Lunar Valkyrie now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Lunar Valkyries have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_7.name: Origin Lunar Valkyrie
star_7.appearance: The final form. Lunar Valkyrie stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Lunar Valkyrie is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Stormborn-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Lesser Apocalypse Zeus Thunder King
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Apocalypse Zeus Thunder King. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Apocalypse Zeus Thunder Kings in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Apocalypse Zeus Thunder King
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Lesser Umbral Water Sprite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Umbral Water Sprite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Umbral Water Sprites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Umbral Water Sprite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Waning Wind Sprites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Waning Wind Sprite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Waning Wind Sprite
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Waning Wind Sprite bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Waning Wind Sprite
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Waning Wind Sprite — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Waning Wind Sprite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Waning Wind Sprite the Feared
star_6.appearance: Waning Wind Sprite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Waning Wind Sprites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

star_7.name: Origin Waning Wind Sprite

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Waning Wind Sprite is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Supreme Supreme Inquisitor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Supreme Supreme Inquisitor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Supreme Supreme Inquisitors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Supreme Supreme Inquisitor

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Blessed Acolyte Young — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Blessed Acolyte Young is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Blessed Acolyte Young the Revered
star_6.appearance: Blessed Acolyte Young now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Blessed Acolyte Youngs have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_7.name: World-Ender Blessed Acolyte Young
star_7.appearance: The final form. Blessed Acolyte Young stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Blessed Acolyte Young is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Iron Temple Acolyte VIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Stirring Iron Temple Acolyte VI
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Iron Temple Acolyte VI
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Iron Temple Acolyte VI bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Iron Temple Acolyte VI
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Iron Temple Acolyte VI — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Iron Temple Acolyte VI is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Iron Temple Acolyte VI the Undying
star_6.appearance: Iron Temple Acolyte VI now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Iron Temple Acolyte VIs have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_7.name: Apex Iron Temple Acolyte VI

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Iron Temple Acolyte VI is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Bud Crowned Angel Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crowned Angel Champion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Crowned Angel Champions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Crowned Angel Champion
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Fledgling Lightning Sprite II
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Lightning Sprite II. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Lightning Sprite IIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rising Lightning Sprite II
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Spawn Rune Garuda Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rune Garuda Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Rune Garuda Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Rune Garuda Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rune Garuda Scout

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Rune Garuda Scout
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_6.name: Rune Garuda Scout the True

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Rune Garuda Scouts have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.

base_chain.name: Spawn Altar Priest

base_chain.name: Newborn Night Celestial Monk
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Night Celestial Monk. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Night Celestial Monks in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Night Celestial Monk
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Hatchling Trainee Angel Ancient

base_chain.name: Young Pale Shrine Acolyte
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Pale Shrine Acolyte. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Pale Shrine Acolytes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Pale Shrine Acolyte
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Iron Night Angel — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Iron Night Angel is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Iron Night Angel the Last
star_6.appearance: Iron Night Angel now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Iron Night Angels have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_7.name: Origin Iron Night Angel
star_7.appearance: The final form. Iron Night Angel stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Iron Night Angel is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Newborn Chapel Knight I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Chapel Knight I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Chapel Knight Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Chapel Knight I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Bud Wind Sprite Elite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Wind Sprite Elite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Wind Sprite Elites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Wind Sprite Elite

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Wisp Malevolent Ifrit Scout

base_chain.name: Newborn Shrine Knight

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Shrine Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Royal Grand Crusader the Ancient

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Royal Grand Crusaders have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Hatchling Wind Sprite

base_chain.name: Lesser Dingy Divine Monk V
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dingy Divine Monk V. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Dingy Divine Monk Vs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Bud Tar Chapel Priest Omega
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Tar Chapel Priest Omega. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Tar Chapel Priest Omegas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Tar Chapel Priest Omega

base_chain.name: Spawn Blessed Guard Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Blessed Guard Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Blessed Guard Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Blessed Guard Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Divine Sprites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Divine Sprite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Divine Sprite
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Divine Sprite bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Divine Sprite
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Divine Sprite — Radiant Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Radiant path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Divine Sprite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Divine Sprite Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Divine Sprite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Divine Sprites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_7.name: Eternal Divine Sprite
star_7.appearance: The final form. Divine Sprite stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Divine Sprite is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Final Threshold" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Cult Order-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Pup Chapel Monk Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Chapel Monk Alpha. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Chapel Monk Alphas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Chapel Monk Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Lesser Apprentice Valkyrie Junior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Apprentice Valkyrie Junior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Apprentice Valkyrie Juniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Apprentice Valkyrie Junior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Apprentice Valkyrie Junior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Apprentice Valkyrie Junior bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Apprentice Valkyrie Junior
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Apprentice Valkyrie Junior — Radiant Sovereign

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Radiant Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Apprentice Valkyrie Junior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Divine Threshold. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Apprentice Valkyrie Junior the Undying
star_6.appearance: Apprentice Valkyrie Junior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Apprentice Valkyrie Juniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

lore_summary: A creature of the Divine Threshold, aligned with Divine energy. Known among tamers as a Celestial-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Divine tamers are called Prelates. They form bonds through shared prayers and ritual fasting.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Night Novice Angel Feral
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Night Novice Angel Feral. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Divine Threshold. Night Novice Angel Ferals in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rising Night Novice Angel Feral
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Divine — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Divine Threshold. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Night Novice Angel Feral
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Night Novice Angel Feral bears the aesthetic of Divine Threshold — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Divine crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Divine Threshold. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  attention is prayer. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Night Novice Angel Feral
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Divine Threshold-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Radiant Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Divine Threshold, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster
